attacked.attack: The conclusion states that the receipt is valued using the telegraphic transfer buying rate on the last day of the tax year (31 March 2027). However, Rule 206 specifies that the specified date for 'Income from other sources' is the last day of the tax year of the assessee, which would be 31 March 2027 only if the tax year aligns with the financial year. If the tax year is different, this date might not be accurate.

Last day of the tax year of the assessee.
